schema_version: 1
contract_set: TEACHER_FLOW_CONTRACT_V1
status: frozen_for_d8_w3_c
purpose: >-
  Current supported Teacher proof: a gateway-authenticated student completes
  Teacher onboarding, submits a general Dialog turn, and receives a durable
  Teacher reply generated through the confidential AI Prompt contract.
scope:
  includes:
    - Teacher onboarding and its Student, Dialog, and Learning Planner boundaries
    - general Dialog-triggered Teacher response generation
    - Student bounded learner context
    - confidential AI Prompt execution and Dialog response delivery
  excludes:
    - Course lesson context
    - Practice and project context
    - TZ authoring
    - Statistic, Telegram, and Next Best Action
invariants:
  - Teacher never selects an AI provider, model, or response schema.
  - Teacher persists no raw prompt, private Dialog history, or provider response.
  - The Dialog source event identity is the generation and append idempotency key.
  - A downstream failure leaves the Teacher job retryable or blocked and never records a false delivery.
  - Accepted Planner onboarding handoff is non-executable admission only.
boundaries:
  - id: TCHR-ACTOR-01
    owner: ms-go-teacher-agent
    producer: trusted gateway after Auth/Identity/User authentication
    consumer: Teacher public API
    transport: HTTP
    methods:
      - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/onboarding/ensure
    request_version: teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1
    response_version: teacher-onboarding-session.v3
    authentication: gateway-attributed student identity and allowed student role
    success: Teacher resolves the actor's persistent Teacher onboarding session.
    failure: unauthenticated or unauthorized actor fails before Teacher state mutation.
    idempotency: current endpoint replay semantics use the persisted onboarding session.

  - id: TCHR-STUDENT-01
    owner: ms-go-student
    producer: Student private API
    consumer: Teacher onboarding and general-context builders
    transport: HTTP
    methods:
      - GET /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/draft
      - POST /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns
      - GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learner-overview
    request_version: student-onboarding and student-learner-overview.v2
    response_version: Student-owned onboarding projection and student-learner-overview.v2
    authentication: exact internal Teacher-scoped token
    success: Teacher receives a bounded, identity-matched Student projection.
    failure: malformed, unavailable, or identity-mismatched data fails closed; the dependent Teacher operation does not synthesize context.
    idempotency: Student turn commands retain their stable Teacher command identity.

  - id: TCHR-DIALOG-01
    owner: ms-go-dialog
    producer: Teacher onboarding provisioner
    consumer: Dialog Teacher-dialog private API
    transport: HTTP
    methods:
      - PUT /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure
    request_version: teacher-dialog-binding.v1
    response_version: teacher-dialog-binding.v1
    authentication: exact internal token
    success: Dialog owns one active Teacher binding and student membership for the returned Dialog.
    failure: conflict, malformed response, or unavailable Dialog fails closed and onboarding remains incomplete.
    idempotency: Dialog owns canonical binding reuse for the same Teacher/student relationship.

  - id: TCHR-PLANNER-01
    owner: ms-go-learning-planner
    producer: Teacher product-aware onboarding workflow
    consumer: Learning Planner private API
    transport: HTTP
    methods:
      - POST /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-readiness
      - POST /internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-plan-handoffs
    request_version: learning-readiness-request.v1 and teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1
    response_version: learning-readiness.v1 and teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1
    authentication: exact Teacher-scoped Planner token
    success: current readiness is accepted and, when eligible, a non-executable onboarding handoff is durably admitted.
    failure: stale, unavailable, malformed, or non-ready result blocks the onboarding path without creating a course, path, or lesson.
    idempotency: handoff uses a stable UUID key and immutable request hash; readiness is state-fenced.

  - id: TCHR-DIALOG-02
    owner: ms-go-dialog
    producer: Dialog general-message workflow
    consumer: Teacher durable Dialog-event intake and delivery workflow
    transport: NATS JetStream and HTTP
    methods:
      - DIALOG_EVENTS:dialog.teacher.requested
      - GET /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/request/{sourceMessageID}
      - POST /internal/v1/teacher-dialog/{dialogID}/message
    request_version: dialog.teacher.requested.v2 and teacher-dialog-request-context.v1
    response_version: bounded context projection and committed Teacher-authored Dialog message
    authentication: NATS stream authorization plus exact HTTP internal token
    success: Teacher durably accepts the source event, verifies bounded context ownership, and Dialog commits one response to the exact source message.
    failure: malformed or conflicting events terminate; transient dependency failures retry; a failed append leaves no false delivered response.
    idempotency: source event_id is the Teacher generation key and Dialog append key.

  - id: TCHR-AIP-01
    owner: ms-go-ai-prompt
    producer: Teacher Dialog worker
    consumer: AI Prompt confidential execution API
    transport: HTTP
    methods:
      - POST /api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential
      - GET /api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/{eventID}
    request_version: teacher.response.v1 confidential execution
    response_version: teacher.response.v1 structured result
    authentication: exact internal token
    provider_selection: owned by the active AI Prompt template; caller override is forbidden
    success: AI Prompt returns a schema-valid nonblank bounded result that Teacher retains only as private pending delivery.
    failure: provider, transport, invalid-input, or invalid-result failure follows current durable retry or blocked semantics with no generated fallback.
    idempotency: dialog.teacher.requested.event_id, including confidential execution replay.
